daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you major clarity vibes today, Libra. Your intuition is *chef's kiss* right now—trust those gut feelings you've been second-guessing. This is your moment to lean into authenticity.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, romantic energy is flowing through your connections today. If you've been holding back on expressing something real, the universe is basically nudging you to go for it. vulnerability looks good on you.
daily.career: Your creative problem-solving is at peak levels today. That project or idea you've been sitting on? The energy says it's ready to move forward. You've got the clarity to pitch it or take the next step with confidence.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. Think yoga, dancing, a walk outside—something that reconnects you with yourself. Mental health check-in: journaling or talking to someone you trust would feel really grounding.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to embrace your natural magnetism, Libra. Venus is whispering about authenticity over perfection, so lean into what feels genuinely you. Trust the timing of things unfolding.
weekly.love: Someone's been noticing your vibe lately. Whether it's deepening an existing connection or attracting fresh energy, this is a moment to be honest about what you actually want instead of what looks good.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. Don't hold back in meetings or creative spaces. The universe is rewarding bold moves and unexpected contributions, so speak up even if it feels unconventional.
weekly.health: Your nervous system is asking for rest disguised as fun. Find activities that feel nourishing rather than draining—think less hustle culture, more intentional downtime. Movement and stillness in balance.
